walletId.title: The wallet
walletId.description: The identifier of the wallet whose node is used to resolve the data.

linkedJson.title: The JSON to be resolved
linkedJson.description: The JSON data from which the resolution starts.

digestData.title: External digest data
digestData.description: The external digest data (e.g. GDPR) stored by the application.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: The policies used during the resolution.

onResolutionFailure.title: Expected behavior on resolution failure
onResolutionFailure.description: Field indicating whether to raise an exception or ignore the error if a resolution fails.

onCyclicResolution.title: Expected behavior on cyclic resolution
onCyclicResolution.description: Field indicating whether to raise an exception or ignore the error if a cyclic resolution is detected.
